newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish central bank welcomes new finance minister.
newsitem.headline: Polish central bank welcomes new finance minister.

text.p: Polish central bank chief Hanna Gronkiewicz-Waltz on Tuesday praised new Finance Minister Marek Belka for pro-market views which are likely to ensure a continuation of present economic policies.

"Mr Belka supports anti-inflationary policies and important structual changes of the economy. He is relatively unknown but, on the basis of his work, credible," Gronkiewicz-Waltz told Reuters in a brief telephone interview.

Formerly presidential economic adviser Belka, 45, replaced Grzegorz Kolodko on Tuesday. Kolodko quit saying he did not want to be sucked into the campaigning for parliamentary elections due in autumn this year.
Gronkiewicz-Waltz said Kolodko's strong personality often made cooperation with the finance ministry difficult and added that work with the even-tempered Belka might prove less trying.
But she credited Kolodko with keeping on track many of the market reforms started after the fall of communism in 1989.
